task.title: Expose OSS activation-ready operations in BFF
task.summary_zh: 補 BFF operator read/control surface：capability、gate state、run history、artifact refs、logs/error summary 都能一站式看見，但不提供直接繞過 governance 的啟用。
acceptance: BFF reads capability and gate state via service-backed clients
BFF exposes run history artifact refs logs and errors for OSS lanes
BFF commands cannot bypass activation gates or governance
BFF tests cover closed gate and enabled offline status
legacy snapshot fallback is not used for staging production paths
